title: Development of bioactive SF/HAp/ZnO scaffolds incorporating succinic acid with potential bone regeneration capabilities
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9358-9370
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04926A, Paper

Sadia Habib, Aysha Arshad, Hafsah Akhtar, Fahad Hussain Alhamoudi, Gülderen Karakuş, Gültekin Gökce, Aqif Anwar Chaudhry, Hamad Khalid, Ather Farooq Khan
SF/HA/ZnO scaffolds with SA were fabricated via freeze gelation, exhibited good swelling, hydrophilicity, and controlled in vitro degradation and supported pre-osteoblast viability, indicating strong potential for bone regeneration.
